Class HighlightedBlockSpawner

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.api.HighlightedBlockSpawner
Direct Known Subclasses:
HighlightedBlockSpawnerSpigot
public abstract class HighlightedBlockSpawner extends Object
Represents a highlighted animated block. These can be useful for highlighting locations and structures.
